validator_tools.location: validator scratch directory outside the repository; not committed
validator_tools.method: jq extracts raw record fields only (ICV1 p, t, r; G; Q; recovered d; total_gae; phase gae; cost.unpriced names with counts looked up in counters, else phase native maps as X_uncharged or X; work_native table and sibling counters with their counted: markers; bitops). check.rs does the curve and scalar arithmetic (affine, u128), the 5a pricing S(w) = (G + w*U)/sqrt(r), the pairing by (workload, round) over measured verified runs, the ratio of summed S, the delta-method log interval over workload clusters with its own Student-t quantile (incomplete beta), per-curve ratios, band means, and the WLS slope. It was written from the AGENTS.md 5a text and the band.rs module contract and shares no code with ecbench.

errata.severity: secondary claims (bit-op figures); GAE headline and band unaffected
errata.location: src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/work.rs (a6a9750f53 put the rule in generic_rule, which only non-IC methods reach); PROTOCOL.md 'Why' ('bitop/v1 prices them at 2 field multiplications and 2 word compares'); the aut help text in ic_framework/plugins.rs; README 'Bit-ops' paragraph; PYTHON-PROVENANCE.md's Stage 4 bit-op check
errata.issue: The E1 fix did not reach bitop/v1 for ic.pipeline records. work.rs prices ic.* phase counters through ic_rule, which has no entry for aut_canonicalisations_uncharged. So 1,260/1,260 aut3 records list it in work.unpriced and their bitops omit 2 field_mul + 2 word_op per canonicalisation; rho-cubic's rotations are priced (2 field_mul, 3 modr_mul, 2 field_add each). This is Stage 4's E4, still present. The validator prices each canonicalisation at 2 field_mul + 2 word_op. Its gates (fp mul(b) = 2(b^2 + 5b(b-1)) + 13b, word_op 64) reproduce the records' own bitops. With them: sib8-p512-aut3 / tw2cj-lazy is 0.589 / 0.538 / 0.540, not the README's 0.368 / 0.334 / 0.334. sib8-p512-aut3 / rho-cubic is 0.995 / 0.881 / 0.917, not 0.621 / 0.547 / 0.568 (README: 'not used'). tw2cj-lazy-aut3 / tw2cj-lazy is 0.770 / 0.775 / 0.791, not 0.561 / 0.563 / 0.575. sib8-p512-aut3 / sib8-p512 is 0.945 / 0.912 / 0.981, not 0.590 / 0.567 / 0.608. Every IC record (aut3 or not) also has work.complete = false (tw_* counters unclassified), so every IC bit-op price is a lower bound.
errata.fix: Add aut_canonicalisations_uncharged to ic_rule, not generic_rule. Re-price, by an explicit re-pricing reading or a new stage. Restate the README bit-op line as a lower bound for the aut3 arms. Correct the PROTOCOL/plugins/commit statements where they are cited again.

observations.note: The 5a band (AGENTS.md 5a, band.rs) charges no word-level work on any arm. The largest such count is rho's cycle-window compares (work_native.cycle_window_word_ops: 17.4 / 17.7 / 17.8 per step on rho-cubic). These are priced in bitop/v1 only; research/rho_cycle_window_bitops_20261107 states that the GAE unit is unchanged. The IC arms' hash and key-compare word operations are not counted at all, so no symmetric band reading that charges word operations exists. The validator neither computes nor requests one; it is flagged so the owner can decide whether the band's 'native operation' should ever include word operations.

boundaries.automorphisms_used is 2 on every ic.pipeline record, including the aut=3 arms, which fold 6. This is metadata only: floor_s uses automorphisms_available = 6, and no ratio reads automorphisms_used.

At w = 0, sib8-p512-aut3 runs at 1.012 / 0.934 / 0.959 x the A = 6 generic floor, because each sibling pair's second point and each lift are native operations priced at 0 at w = 0 (Stage 4's E5). The w = 0 ratio is a lower bound for the IC arm. The README cites it only with the band and makes no below-rho claim.

The slope uses 15 curves in three size bands (log2 r 33.3-40.0), fewer than the four sizes AGENTS.md 5 asks for an exponent fit. The producer makes no exponent claim. 'Flat in r' means the slope interval contains 0 over this range.
The panel ran locally at L0, not on the EKS default; PROTOCOL.md froze that route. Operation counts do not depend on isolation, and no wall-time result is claimed.

The README's 'at w = 1 the sibling mechanism no longer pays' is supported by the direct paired ratio sib8-p512-aut3 / tw2cj-lazy-aut3 at w = 1: 1.083 [1.018, 1.152] (p34), 0.984 [0.939, 1.031] (p37), 0.968 [0.911, 1.030] (p40). At w = 0 the ratio is 0.537 / 0.485 / 0.476. Band order: unresolved at p34, sib lower at every weight at p37 and p40.
